text:
Anya K: FYI found a bunch of tenants being routed to v1 even when they include X-API-Version: v2. Repro steps attached.
Devon R: thanks, what's the common factor? token metadata mismatch?
Anya K: sometimes token has no explicit version affinity and our fallback hash ends up in v1. But a few tenants explicitly set header v2 and still went to v1.
Priya S: that suggests our decision order might be ambiguous when both token and header exist. We treat token affinity as authoritative today.
Marco L: yes. Current code path: token_affinity -> header -> rollover. Token wins if present.
Anya K: customers complain because they expect header to be a direct override. Support tickets starting to appear.
Devon R: naive fix is to swap order to header -> token -> fallback, but that changes routing for many tenants. Need a safer approach.
Priya S: propose three-step: 1) audit-only sampling run that logs what WOULD have happened if header had precedence (no actual routing change), 2) per-tenant opt-in switch in Console, 3) small cohort opt-in by platform for a pilot.
Marco L: audit-only sounds low-risk. We can add a boolean in traces: `routing.audit.header_precedence_would_win` and emit counts with `routing.audit.header_precedence.sampled` metric.
Devon R: what sampling rate? Start at 0.5% global and 5% for targeted tenants.
Anya K: also need a metric to show the downstream effect: `routing.change_projection.affected_sessions` and tags for pool_type (dedicated/shared), latency_delta_percentile.
Priya S: console UX: add toggle on Tenant settings called "Prefer client version header" with explanation and an "Estimate impact" button that runs projection job.
Marco L: projection job can use last 7 days of routing logs and estimate how many sessions would move pools. We'll include cost delta and likely latency impact.
Devon R: for safety, if a tenant opts in and error rate spikes, auto revert to previous routing for 15 minutes and create alert. Thresholds: >2x error rate sustained for 3 minutes or absolute >4% error increase.
Anya K: agree. Also add an opt-out grace period where we keep the old affinity sticky for 1 hour after revert to avoid flip-flopping.
Priya S: telemetry naming suggestions: `routing.version_override.count` with tag `source=header|token|fallback`, `routing.version_override.sample_rate`, `routing.projection.cost_delta`.
Marco L: add logs to show per-request decision delta for sampled requests: `decision_before=token`, `decision_after=header`. Keep these logs in ephemeral table for 30 days.
Devon R: quota effects: if a tenant moves from Dedicated to Shared, we should precompute quota headroom and show a warning. Metric `quota.estimated_shortfall` in tenant console.
Anya K: ops needs a dashboard tile listing tenants with non-zero estimated_shortfall and a suggested mitigation (schedule migration, purchase reserved capacity, or stay on token affinity).
Priya S: rollout plan timeline: Day 0-3 implement audit sampling + metrics. Day 4-7 add console opt-in + projection job. Day 8 start 50-tenant pilot via opt-in. Day 15 review pilot and decide on broader flip.
Marco L: I'll add a router flag `routing.header_preference_optin` (per-tenant tri-state: off/audit/on) and expose via Console and API.
ops-bot: Created ticket ENG-4472: "version handshake audit + opt-in + projection" assigned to @Marco L and @Priya S. ETA: 7 days for audit + projection POC.
Devon R: small note: docs should be clear: clients SHOULD avoid sending multiple conflicting version signals. Recommend pins in SDKs and examples.
Anya K: also add an audit-only alert to surface when a tenant would have moved pools so support can proactively contact them.
Priya S: I'll draft console copy and a help center article. Will include examples and recommended SDK changes.
Marco L: implementation detail: keep sampling writes lightweight; use existing metrics pipeline and K/V tags. Limit sampled trace payload to ~200 bytes.
Devon R: good. Let's review the metrics dashboard mock in next eng-platform sync.
Anya K: thanks all. Leaving the thread open for updates.
